verdict.rationale: Recurly explicitly offers 'RevRec' which automates revenue recognition for ASC 606, IFRS 15/16, ASC 842, and ASC 340-40, including automated contract modifications and real-time insights, and the data export docs explicitly call out revenue recognition reporting. This directly matches the finance-lead story, though details on specific deferred revenue schedule formats and audit-trail granularity are thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of RevRec's audit-ready outputs, and deeper documentation on deferred revenue schedule specifics beyond the one-line summary.
